campaign.title: Common recombined physical-height kernel

resource_policy.literature_policy: Use exact endpoint subtraction, Taylor cancellation, Mellin inversion, physical-height coordinates, and finite-contour side ledgers. Search primary literature only for a specifically named uniform incomplete-Mellin or Hilbert-symbol theorem, and audit hard endpoints and parameter-uniform hypotheses before use.

frozen_target.question: Can one form the exact common physical-height regular kernel for omega G+(1-omega)R1-omega E1 and prove its lambda^(-2)/lambda^(-3) weighted symbol bounds through rho=0, the v=0 axial split, finite radial sides, and joint U,V,S exhaustion?
frozen_target.reference_formula: After identical-mask recombination and one combined delta/log subtraction, prove |K_complete(L,nu)| <= X^epsilon lambda^(-2) w_b(nu) and |partial_L K_complete(L,nu)| <= X^epsilon lambda^(-3) w_b(nu), with integrable w_b, compatible translated endpoint traces, polylogarithmic b loss after extracting v=0, and summable radial/height sides.
quantities: ordinary L derivative at fixed physical nu
v=0 axial residue and b downarrow zero
full h,D_j,x,q and external normalization ledger

completion_criteria: One exact common physical-height kernel is written before termwise estimates.
The rho Taylor/cutoff ledger and combined diagonal subtraction are exact.
Weighted value and ordinary L-derivative bounds are proved or the first exact coefficient violating them is isolated.
The v=0 axial residue and b limit are reconciled once.
Finite radial sides and joint U,V,S tails are bounded or isolated quantitatively.
A blind derivation and hostile audit independently assess the result.
The conductor closes the round before choosing the next objective.

tasks.target: Independently derive the most explicit common physical-height regular kernel licensed by the accepted Round-27 and Round-31 statements, including rho Taylor cancellation, one combined diagonal/log subtraction, axial ownership, radial endpoints, and finite sides. Prove the weighted symbol bounds or isolate the first missing exact coefficient. Do not read Round-32 claimant reports.
required_output: Exact common-kernel identity or first definition obstruction
Weighted-symbol proof or exact missing coefficient
Seven-section report at the assigned path

tasks.target: Construct K_complete(L,nu), expand the rho-regular Taylor package, extract the axial residue, and prove the lambda^(-2)/lambda^(-3) weighted bounds with radial-side and joint-height exhaustion. If full closure fails, isolate the smallest exact radial or axial operator and quantify its capacity.
required_output: Complete weighted-symbol proof or smallest explicit survivor
Axial, radial-side, tail, and normalization ledger
Seven-section report at the assigned path

Construct an actual-factor counterexample or certify the narrowest lemma.
required_output: Seven-section report at the assigned path
